Chapter 842 03-25 - Chapter 33 Fully Understand (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 842: Chapter 33 Fully Understand (Subscription Request)_2

Before the ‘White Paper’ descended, the large battlefield of different races where Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit was, was already brewing a highly intense battle, with an assembly of Level Eleven powerhouses.

Even the strongest warriors of the Star Alliance, to ensure victory, mobilized the Four Divine Kings fused with the most powerful weapons, hoping to use them as the final trump card to settle the outcome.

Such situations were extremely rare, not necessarily occurring even once in a million or ten million years.

But if a super-dimensional battlefield is successfully established, clashes among Level Eleven powerhouses would become the norm, and the suppressive forces would become those holding the most powerful weapons at Level Eleven Perfect, even ultimate existences will intervene.

“However, it doesn’t have much to do with us.”

The Lustrous Star Master expressed this with ease, as if saying that while a large battlefield belongs to Level Ten powerhouses, a super-dimensional battlefield is the stage for Level Eleven powerhouses.

And as a Level Ten, the Lustrous Star Master would most likely still be stationed on a large battlefield.

“I have a premonition that at the start of this new battlefield, an extremely brutal war will inevitably break out.”

The Black Star Lord spoke solemnly, whether it’s a small, medium, or large battlefield, at their inception, the intensity of war tends to be terrifyingly high.

Many peak race forces are all striving to secure the dominion over the battlefield.

The super-dimensional battlefield is no exception, and compared to past large battlefields, the brutality of war in a super-dimensional battlefield is estimated to reach a horrifying level.

…

After finishing the casual conversation with the Black Star Lord and other Class A Level Ten warriors.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in the Star Lord’s Great Hall.

“Super-dimensional battlefield of different races…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was deep, the establishment of a super-dimensional battlefield had an extremely profound impact, as many peak race forces including human civilization would go all out, which is very likely to spark clashes between the strongest warriors.

“It’s about time for a breakthrough to Level Eleven.”

Lin Yuan felt that all aspects had reached an optimal state, contemplating quietly in his heart.

At this moment.

A slight movement stirred in Lin Yuan’s heart.

His gaze looked distantly in the direction of the thirteenth most important location of human civilization.

“Who would have thought that I would become a Demon Jade Tower Member before the breakthrough to Level Eleven?”

Lin Yuan was slightly surprised inside, the conditions to be a Demon Jade Tower Member are to thoroughly understand all demonic evolution paths.

And the life level is capped below Level Twelve.

Originally, Lin Yuan planned to advance to Level Eleven first and then go all out to strike for the status of a Demon Jade Tower Member.

After all, moving from a core member to a listed member is not like storming through levels, where the more potential demonstrated, the richer the reward.

One just needs to meet the predetermined conditions.

But now, this goal seems to have been accomplished prior to the breakthrough to Level Eleven.

…

The thirteenth most important location of human civilization.

Inside a grand hall at its depth.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In the depths of his soul memory, various demonic evolution pathways seemed to reach a certain qualitative change, beginning to converge into that Demon Jade Tower core member mark.

Buzzing sounds emanated.

The Magic Jade Mark was rapidly transforming.

“So, the number of all demonic evolution pathways is thirty-three million three hundred thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three?”

At this moment Lin Yuan finally knew the specific quantity of demonic evolution pathways contained within his body.

When he first observed that body in the Virtual World, Lin Yuan only felt that the evolutionary paths contained within its flesh were as vast as a sea of smoke.

But now, this ‘vast sea of smoke’ finally had a definite upper limit.

With a mental will capable of easily resisting the spiritual pressure within the body, Lin Yuan’s understanding of demonic evolution pathways was as fast as a thousand li per day would not be an overstatement.

In just a few months, he had far surpassed the results of hundreds of years of contemplation.

“The ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’, I have also successfully comprehended the First Tier Chapter and Second Layer Chapter, as for the Twelve Tier Chapter…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

After all, this body was ultimately incomplete, and since the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” had already been deciphered, the traces left by the Twelve Tier Chapter were completely just scraps.

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even scraps could allow him to comprehend the whole picture.

However, Level Twelve was ultimately too far beyond Lin Yuan’s current realm, and even if he could comprehend the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” of Level Twelve, it would take a lot of time.

“The First Tier Chapter and Second Layer Chapter are enough for me.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, currently unaware of when he will attempt the breakthrough, the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” of the Second Layer Chapter is already sufficient for a long time to come.

“The ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’ of the First Tier level still brings a significant enhancement to my physical body.”

Lin Yuan, in the moment of comprehending the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” up to the Tenth Layer Chapter and Eleventh Layer Chapter, is equivalent to having cultivated it to perfection, save for the fact that his physical strengthening has yet to catch up.

In truth, after Lin Yuan cultivated the “Xuanhuang Physique” to the Tenth Layer Perfect Level, nearly all other body refining methods held little benefit for him.

After all, the “Xuanhuang Physique” could already be termed perfect, at the Tenth Layer level, the areas that could be tempered and elevated had been virtually all tempered and elevated.

Other body refining methods simply couldn’t perform better, and even if they were cultivated to the realm of perfection, they would be overshadowed by the “Xuanhuang Physique”, with a negligible effect on the enhancement of the physical body.

But what about the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body”? This method of body refinement was entirely distinct from the “Xuanhuang Physique”, if it could also reach the level of perfection.

Lin Yuan believed his physical body would be able to advance even further.

…

As Lin Yuan contemplated,

deep within his soul, that Magic Jade Mark finally completed its transformation.

At the same time,

a deep and hoarse male voice echoed in Lin Yuan’s mind:

“Upon fully comprehending all demonic evolutionary pathways, automatically become a Demon Jade Tower Member.”

…

“Demon and Tower Sequence Member?” A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face. Hadn’t he sent an incarnation here specifically to comprehend, just for this moment?

“This Magic Jade Mark…” Lin Yuan immediately sensed the changes in the Magic Jade Mark.

It became more profound, more mysterious.

“I vaguely feel through this Magic Jade Mark the specific spatial coordinates of that Demon Jade Space?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

As an ordinary member and core member of the Magic Jade Tower, Lin Yuan could only descend into the Demon Jade Space using the Magic Jade Mark.

As for more, he was not sure.

But now?

He could sense the specific coordinates of the Demon Jade Space?

It was known that the Demon Jade Space, opened by the Moyu Tower Master, could only be entered by members of the Demon Jade Tower.

The outside world has no knowledge of its location; even the members of the Demon Jade Tower are unclear about the position of the Demon Jade Space.

“Is this the privilege of being a Sequence Member?”

Lin Yuan had an idea in his mind.

If the core members of the Magic Jade Tower are the elite, then the Sequence Members are the pillars, the foundation.

Above the Sequence Members lies the Direct Disciples of the Moyu Tower Master, those who are cultivated as future Tower Masters and supreme beings.

The privileges of Demon Jade Tower Members are substantial. They can even take over some of the rights to the Demon Jade Space.

“That place… too distant…”

Lin Yuan followed the connection of the Magic Jade Mark and vaguely looked in a certain direction.

Even though he had already learned from the Statue Shen Ji that the Demon Jade Space was not located within any universe,

the moment Lin Yuan truly felt the precise location of the Demon Jade Space, his heart still surged with shock.

It was like an ordinary person who has never left his village looking up at the stars above the firmament, estimating the distance of the stars from himself.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan observed the Magic Jade Mark deep within his soul for a while before stopping.

The mark of a Demon Jade Tower Member is many times more complex than that of a core member, but what exactly are the differences? With Lin Yuan’s current level, it was hard to tell.

“Take another trip to the Demon Jade Space.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and then split off a sliver of will, following the connection of the Magic Jade Mark, instantaneously crossing infinite distances, descending into a certain Mysterious Space.

Demon Jade Space.

As this sliver of Lin Yuan’s will descended, the entire Demon Jade Space seemed to detect something, trembling slightly. The surrounding grey fog suddenly dispersed, much like the weather clearing up after being gloomy for a long time.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan glanced around and directly headed for the location of the nine-story Black Tower.

…

Outside the nine-story Black Tower.

The Statue Shen Ji, immersed in sleep, was abruptly awakened by the tremor in the Demon Jade Space.

“What is this?”

Statue Shen Ji could hardly believe it, and then his eyes moistened, “My Magic Jade Tower has finally birthed another Sequence Member?”
